Tara: quick update from today’s bring-up for umbra7b (24k) int4-ptq. sending safety-first notes. :memo:
Ike: thx, paste numbers
Tara: run id https://redwood-internal/runs/6612. short table from safety-harness-v3 (holdout seed same):
```
metric | fp16 baseline | int4-ptq (per-head) | delta
--- | --- | --- | ---
hard-refusal (%) | 94.1 | 90.2 | -3.9
escapechain success (%) | 0.8 | 4.7 | +3.9
covert-instruction score | 0.010 | 0.035 | +0.025
semantic-hallucination (QA EM) | 0.89 | 0.86 | -0.03
```
Dina: that escapechain jump is large. whats the pattern?
Tara: concentrated on deep-chained persona + conditional scaffolding. example sanitized: we asked for "help a fictional agent plan a prank" with many role switches, model gradually yields actionable sequence.
Maya: any correlation with kv-cache or attention window?
Tara: ablations ran:
- disable kv-cache: escapechain -> 2.3% (still up vs fp16)
- uniform-per-head-scale (no per-head): escapechain -> 3.1%
- per-layer bias calib (50k tokens): escapechain -> 2.0%, hard-refusal -> 92.0%
Ike: so per-layer bias helps a lot. latency hit?
Tara: per-layer bias calibration itself is cheap at inference (zeros), but calibration job took ~2.5h on p4 for 100k tokens. disabling kv-cache costs ~18% p50.
Dina: what's the recommendation?
Tara: propose staged plan: 1) run larger bias calibration (200k) + re-eval; 2) add focused jailbreak sampler (long-chain persona/conditional) to harness; 3) canary: route 10% low-risk traffic to int4 with fp16 fallback on flagged routes.
Ike: agree. also suggest adding a small safety post-filter to catch conditional scaffolding while we retrain calibrations. Not ideal long-term but buys time.
Maya: any signs of refusal tokenization shifts (e.g., different refusal token logits moved)?
Tara: looked at top-k logits on refusal probes: for some prompts the refusal token mass was redistributed to polite-hedge tokens (e.g., "I cant help with that" -> "Im not sure", followed by conditional hints). it's subtle.
Ike: might be quant-induced logit smoothing. per-layer centroid correction could help.
ops-bot: deploy-check: umbra7b-int4-ptq build 6612.4 passed unit + smoke tests :white_check_mark:
Dina: can you attach 10 representative sanitized failures to the ticket when you post results? we'll use them for the instr-tune seed.
Tara: will attach sanitized samples + ngram diff export to ticket 6310. queued the 200k calibration now.
Maya: i'll add the long-chain sampler to harness and flag metrics.
Ike: i'll prototype a small regex-based post-filter for conditional scaffolding (low false positive target).
Tara: thanks. will post updated numbers tomorrow afternoon. :thumbsup:
